# opnsense_caddy_header (Data Source)

Reads a Caddy header operation by UUID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_caddy_header" "preserve_host" {
  id = var.header_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the header operation.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `direction` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `replace` (String)
- `value` (String)
